why: The paper's numbers come from these weights. They are too large for normal git objects (8.5 GB total, over GitHub's free Git LFS quota), so this manifest is the contract: any copy of the file with a matching SHA-256 is the file the paper used. Verify with `python verify_checkpoints.py`.

weights.role: deployed checkpoint: all Table 2/3 numbers, calibration, latency, qualitative examples
Stage-4 initialisation checkpoint; also the provenance behind section 3 and the Stage-2 comparison row

shipped vision LoRA adapter (192 tensors, r=16)
shipped custom heads: cls_head, attn_pool, freq_branch, custom_projector, domain_router (59 tensors)
